open_questions.question: Is her son a Chilean citizen, or does he hold Residencia Definitiva rather than only temporary residence?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This determines whether the parent family-reunification route exists.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain his Chilean birth certificate/citizenship proof or current SERMIG definitive-residence certificate.

open_questions.question: Will a Chilean medical university make a genuine contract or formal job offer before her revalidation is complete, and is the proposed post teaching-only, research, or clinical?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The offer/contract is the practical route to residence, while clinical work has separate licensing barriers.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the prospective university HR/international office for a conditional offer and its credential requirements.

open_questions.question: What is the current Ukraine-specific SERMIG fee for the exact chosen temporary-residence benefit?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The official fee page directs to a nationality table but did not expose a fixed Ukraine amount in the accessible public page.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Check the payment request generated in the live SERMIG application or obtain written confirmation from SERMIG/Warsaw.

open_questions.question: Does her Ukrainian pension/social-security affiliation satisfy Ley 18.156 and will the intended employer classify her as eligible foreign technical personnel?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It determines whether Chilean AFP contributions may be exempted.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Have the employer/payroll provider and an AFP or Chilean labour lawyer review the foreign coverage certificate and proposed contract before signature.

open_questions.question: Which accredited State university has actually opened a post-17-August-2026 recognition/revalidation route for medicine besides Universidad de Chile?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The recent legal empowerment of other universities must not be confused with an operationally available process.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain written confirmation directly from each candidate university; do not rely on older monopoly descriptions.

unknowns_declared: I found no official public, case-specific processing-time commitment for a Ukrainian applicant or the work/family temporary-residence subcategories; aggregate 2025 statistics are not a promise.
I found no reliable current official public figure for Ukraine’s exact temporary-residence fee; it must be confirmed in the live SERMIG payment flow.

I did not treat the pre-17-August-2026 Universidad de Chile material as proof that it remains the sole revalidation authority after Decreto 174/2024. Its current operational instructions do prove that UChile itself accepts a passport-based online start.
No evidence was found that a tax RUT acquired from abroad can substitute for a foreigner RUN/cédula, immigration residence, ClaveÚnica, or medical professional authorisation.
No general maximum-age limit was established for immigration or ordinary employment. Particular public-university/public-health vacancy rules remain employer-specific.
